title: SFace: Privacy-friendly and Accurate Face Recognition using Synthetic Data
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on face recognition accuracy and privacy using synthetically generated data.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
